Great question! While both **Bing** (powered by **Microsoft Copilot**, which uses **GPT-4** and other AI models) and **ChatGPT** (by OpenAI) are AI chatbots, there are some key differences:

### **1. Underlying AI Model & Capabilities**
- **ChatGPT (OpenAI):**
  - Runs on **GPT-3.5 (free version)** or **GPT-4 (paid version)**.
  - Focuses on **general-purpose conversational AI** (writing, coding, brainstorming, etc.).
  - **No real-time web access** (unless using plugins or browsing mode in GPT-4).
  - **Cutoff knowledge:** GPT-3.5 (up to **Jan 2022**), GPT-4 (up to **Oct 2023** in some versions).

- **Bing (Microsoft Copilot):**
  - Uses **GPT-4 (and other Microsoft AI models)** with **real-time web search** (via Bing).
  - Can **fetch live information** (news, stock prices, recent events).
  - **More integrated with Microsoft services** (Office 365, Edge, Windows).
  - **Stronger on structured answers** (tables, citations, sources).

### **2. Internet & Real-Time Data Access**
| Feature          | ChatGPT (Free) | ChatGPT (Plus/Enterprise) | Bing (Copilot) |
|------------------|---------------|--------------------------|---------------|
| **Real-time web search** | ❌ No | ✅ (With plugins/Browsing) | ✅ Yes |
| **Up-to-date info** | ❌ (Cutoff: 2022/2023) | ✅ (Limited) | ✅ (Full) |
| **Sources & citations** | ❌ Rarely | ✅ Sometimes | ✅ Always |

### **3. Integration & Ecosystem**
- **ChatGPT:**
  - Standalone (web & app).
  - **Plugins** (for paid users) extend functionality (e.g., Wolfram Alpha, Zapier).
  - **API access** for developers.

- **Bing (Copilot):**
  - **Deeply integrated** with:
    - **Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)** via **Copilot for Microsoft 365**.
    - **Windows 11** (built-in AI assistant).
    - **Edge browser** (sidebar AI).
  - **Enterprise-focused** (better for business users).

### **4. Response Style & Use Cases**
| Feature          | ChatGPT | Bing (Copilot) |
|------------------|---------|---------------|
| **Creative writing** | ✅ Better (more fluid) | ✅ Good (but more structured) |
| **Coding help** | ✅ Strong (GPT-4) | ✅ Strong (but may pull from web) |
| **Research & facts** | ❌ Limited (old data) | ✅ Better (real-time web) |
| **Conversational tone** | ✅ More natural | ✅ Slightly more formal |
| **Multimodal (images, files)** | ✅ (GPT-4 can analyze images) | ✅ (Limited, but improving) |

### **5. Pricing & Availability**
| Feature          | ChatGPT | Bing (Copilot) |
|------------------|---------|---------------|
| **Free version** | ✅ (GPT-3.5) | ✅ (Full GPT-4 + web access) |
| **Paid version** | ✅ ($20/mo for GPT-4) | ❌ (Free, but Copilot Pro for Office is $20/mo) |
| **Enterprise use** | ✅ (ChatGPT Enterprise) | ✅ (Copilot for Microsoft 365) |

### **6. Safety & Moderation**
- **ChatGPT:**
  - More **strict content filters** (avoids controversial topics).
  - **Less likely to generate harmful content** (but can still "hallucinate" facts).

- **Bing (Copilot):**
  - **More permissive** in some cases (but still has guardrails).
  - **Better at citing sources** (reduces hallucinations).

### **Which One Should You Use?**
| **Use Case** | **Best Choice** |
|-------------|----------------|
| **Creative writing, coding, brainstorming** | ChatGPT (GPT-4) |
| **Research, real-time info, news** | Bing (Copilot) |
| **Microsoft Office integration** | Bing (Copilot for M365) |
| **API/developer access** | ChatGPT (OpenAI API) |
| **Free GPT-4 access** | Bing (Copilot) |
| **Strictly controlled responses** | ChatGPT |

### **Final Verdict**
- **If you need real-time info, citations, or Microsoft integration → Use Bing (Copilot).**
- **If you need creative writing, coding, or API access → Use ChatGPT.**
- **If you want free GPT-4 → Bing is the best option.**
